newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Bond market takes trade at Tunis bourse up.
newsitem.headline: Bond market takes trade at Tunis bourse up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday edged 0.37 percent lower, but bond market activity helped boost trade, bourse sorces said.
The 31-share index closed at 490.62 from 492.45 on Friday.
Volume was 9.49 million dinars against 1.20 million dinars. Turnover on the bonds market was 8.96 million dinars.
Amen Bank fell 1.3 dinars to 58.5 dinars. BDET bank was down 0.48 dinar to 15.62. BTEI bank eased 0.26 dinar to 22.7. Milk company Tunisie Lait declined 0.6 dinar to 20.72 dinars.
Chemical firm ICF won 1.28 dinars to 46.28 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat gained 0.62 dinar to 21.7. UIB bank rose 0.37 dinar to 12.87 dinars. ($= 1.07 dinars)
